cherry._readme: Durable identity corrections consumed by build-company-base.py on every rebuild (COLLECTION.md §8): one company rendered under different names across the four list surfaces (2026 Webflow pages, the 2024-2025 Sanity CMS, the 2016-2023 WordPress listings, the Getro job board) and its rebrands. Canonical = the firm's current rendering where the company is still listed, else the last rendering. never_merge lists pairs proven distinct (an acquirer listed beside the company it bought).
